judgments.rationale: The proposed summary fails to explain the complete waived duty under Subparagraph (A) (which includes providing a copy of the complaint) and omits the surviving notification duty under clause (ii) that must accompany the exemption for independent usability.

The baseline reading in C0000 is not independently complete because it does not reflect the governing incoming exemption in Subparagraph (B)(i), which waives the pre-filing notice requirement when an attorney general determines advance notice is infeasible.
The proposal incorrectly specifies C0002 as the qualification target; Subparagraph (B)(i) is an exception to Subparagraph (A), represented by claim C0000, not clause (ii) represented by C0002.

The edit properly qualifies baseline claim C0000, articulates both the waived pre-filing obligation and the surviving simultaneous notification duty without treating the latter as an invalid prerequisite, and accurately captures all components and scope.

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.
In an action described in clause (i), the attorney general of a State shall provide notice and a copy of the complaint to the Commission at the same time as the attorney general files the action.
